name: Rebuild Font Cache
description: Rebuilds the Windows font cache to fix missing fonts, corrupted previews, or broken text rendering in apps and the system interface.

description_i18n.en: Rebuilds the Windows font cache to fix missing fonts, corrupted previews, or broken text rendering in apps and the system interface.
description_i18n.de: Erstellt den Windows-Schriftarten-Cache neu, um fehlende Schriftarten, beschädigte Vorschaün oder fehlerhafte Textdarstellung in Apps und der Systemoberfläche zu beheben.
description_i18n.fr: Reconstruit le cache des polices de Windows pour corriger les polices manquantes, les aperçus corrompus ou l'affichage du texte cassé dans les applications et l'interface système.

warnings.title: Explorer refresh
warnings.message: Windows Explorer may close and reopen briefly while the font cache is rebuilt

warnings.title: Service state change
warnings.message: Related Windows services may stop or restart briefly while the action runs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Stops the FontCache and FontCache3.0.0.0 services to clear temporary data in LocalService\AppData\Local\FontCache, then deletes FNTCACHE.DAT from System32 before restarting the services
